blocks.text: One added column in the census file would settle the terminated records mentioned below. For each of those people, the file shows a termination date and nothing more. It does not tell us whether they were paid out, are waiting on a deferred benefit, or have already started receiving one.

We have not assumed an answer for any of them, and we would like not to have to. If your benefits staff can add a status from the {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}} records, in whatever terms your system uses, we will map it on our side and load it straight back into the model.
